title: Sharing of identified student data
description: Student shares student id along with assignment submission, providing identified information directly.

title: Processing of identified data at portal
description: Grades Portal Web App receives and processes the student id, enabling identification of the submitter.

title: Identified information potentially in flow metadata
description: Login and submission flow may carry identified information in metadata or headers.

title: Attributable assignment submission record
description: Submission including timestamp and student id creates attributable evidence that the student cannot repudiate.

title: Linking submission via unique student identifier
description: Use of student id as unique identifier allows linking the submitted work to the specific student.

title: Linking through student identifier in data flow
description: The flow transmits student id along with course, file reference and role, enabling linking of grading requests and submissions to specific individuals via the unique student identifier.

title: Processing of identified student data at grading service
description: Assignment & Grading Service receives and processes explicit student id in submission and grading requests, constituting processing of identified information.

title: Attributable grading requests via student id
description: Received data records containing student id and requesting role can be attributed to individuals, preventing denial of submission or grading actions.

title: Storage of identified student data
description: The Assignment Store receives and stores the submitted assignment file containing student id, which constitutes processing of identified data.

title: Attributable submission record
description: The data record with student id and submission time can be used to attribute the assignment submission to the individual student, preventing denial of the action.

title: Login request processes identified data
description: The teacher logs in by sending credentials or identifiers to the Grades Portal Web App, which processes this identified information to authenticate and associate the request with the specific teacher.

title: Login and request creates attributable evidence
description: The act of logging in and requesting the submission queue generates data records that can attribute these actions to the specific teacher, preventing denial of having accessed or reviewed course-related data.

title: Observed login communication reveals activity
description: The communication flow for login and queue request can be observed, detecting that the teacher is accessing the grades portal and requesting submissions for their courses.

title: Sharing of identified student data
description: The Grades Portal Web App shares student names (identified information) along with work content and submission times to the teacher via this flow.

title: Attributable submission evidence
description: Student work content and submission times shared in this flow can serve as data evidence attributing actions to individual students, preventing denial of submission claims.

title: Linking via student names
description: Student names act as unique identifiers in the data flow, enabling linking of submissions and other data to specific individuals.

title: Disclosure to teacher
description: Personal data of students is made accessible to the teacher (predetermined party) through this flow.

title: Processing of identified student and grader data
description: The Grades Portal Web App receives and processes identified data including student id and grader id along with grade and feedback, directly linking the personal evaluation to specific individuals.

title: Linking via unique identifiers in transit
description: The data flow carries unique identifiers (student id, grader id) that enable linking the grade and feedback to specific data subjects during transmission.

title: Disclosure of sensitive educational performance data
description: Teacher shares sensitive data types (grade, written feedback text) which are highly personal and could impact the student's privacy if not strictly necessary, even in a grades system.

title: Attributable grade record prevents denial
description: The recorded grade and feedback with grader id creates attributable evidence that the teacher cannot later deny having submitted for that student.

title: Linking via unique student identifier in grade record
description: Grading service shares grade record containing student id, enabling linking of this record to other data about the same student via the unique identifier.
assumptions: Student id is unique within the system or context.

title: Processing of identified student data
description: The Assignment & Grading Service writes identified data including student id as part of the grade record to the database.

title: Attributable grade data evidence stored
description: Grade record with grader id, timestamp, and student details stored in database can be used as evidence to attribute actions or prevent denial of claims regarding grading.

title: Disclosure of sensitive grade and feedback data
description: Grade and feedback may be perceived as sensitive personal data being written over the flow, potentially more sensitive than minimally required in some contexts.
assumptions: Educational grades and feedback considered sensitive.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if more sensitive than needed; data seems functionally required.

title: Identifier in request for own grades
description: The data flow from the student to the portal carries an identifier (such as student ID, username, or authentication token) to specify whose grades and feedback are being requested.

title: Processing of identified data for grade retrieval
description: The Grades Portal Web App receives and processes identified data in the request to authenticate the student and retrieve their specific grades and feedback.

title: Unawareness as data subject requesting grades
description: The student may not be fully aware of all processing, logging, or storage activities triggered by submitting a request for their grades and feedback.

title: Observed communications reveal grade access
description: An external observer of the data flow between the portal and student may detect the transmission of grades and feedback, revealing that the student is actively receiving academic performance information.
assumptions: Assumes network observability of the display action
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not specify transport protocol, encryption, or network context

title: Processing of identified data via linked accounts
description: Parent shares login credentials and request tied to linked child account, causing the system to process identified personal data of the child.

title: Linking via unique account identifier
description: The data flow uses the parent account link to child account as a unique identifier to associate the request with specific child's grades.

title: Sensitive educational data disclosure
description: The Grades Portal receives and processes the request, leading to disclosure of sensitive child grades data which may be more sensitive than minimally required without additional controls.

title: Child data subject unawareness
description: The child (data subject) may be unaware of the parent's access request and processing of their grades data through the linked account.
uncertainty_note: Based on flow description mentioning linked accounts but no mention of child notification.

title: Processing of identified data
description: The portal sends the child's grades, feedback, and submission history, which constitutes identified personal data about the student.

title: Data shared with predetermined external party
description: Child's academic records are disclosed to the parent as an external entity.

title: Unawareness as data subject
description: The child may be unaware that their grades and related data are being shared with the parent via the portal.

title: Linking through parent-child relationships
description: The data flow includes parent-child links (relationships) which combine data of different individuals (parents and children), enabling linking of their personal data within the Grades Portal Web App.

title: Processing of identified data
description: The Grades Portal Web App receives and processes identified personal data including names and emails for creating, modifying, and disabling accounts and parent-child links.

title: Disclosure of sensitive relationship data
description: The flow transmits sensitive personal data such as parent-child relationships and emails, which may be perceived as highly sensitive in an educational context involving minors.

title: Linking via parent-child relationship data
description: Grading service writes parent-child relationship links along with account records, enabling combination of data from different individuals (parents and children).

title: Linking via stored parent-child links
description: Account directory receives and stores parent-child relationship links, allowing linking of data across different individuals.

title: Propagation of relationship data
description: Parent-child links and account records are propagated via the flow to the account directory.
uncertainty_note: Unclear if this propagation is necessary beyond functional needs based on limited description.

title: Unawareness of stored relationships
description: Data subjects may be unaware that their parent-child relationships are being recorded in the account directory by the grading service.

title: Excessive exposure to third-party cloud provider
description: Full grade records, assignments, and account directory are shipped nightly to a third-party cloud hosting provider for backup and replication, exposing personal data to an external party beyond what may be strictly necessary for core functionality.

title: Excessive volume of personal data in backups
description: Nightly shipping of full grade records and account directory processes an excessive amount of personal data for backup purposes.

title: Prolonged retention at cloud provider
description: The third-party cloud hosting provider receives and likely retains full personal data records for hosting and replication, exceeding functional needs if backups are not time-limited.
uncertainty_note: Retention duration not explicitly stated in flow description

title: Violation of data minimization in sharing to cloud
description: Full records including grades and accounts are shared with external provider, violating data minimization by processing more personal data than strictly needed for the backup function.

title: Data subjects unaware of third-party backup processing
description: Students and users are likely unaware that their grade records, assignments, and account data are being sent nightly to a third-party cloud hosting provider.

title: Identified information in backup metadata or transit
description: The data flow of full records likely includes identified information or metadata that reveals identities during transit to the cloud provider.
uncertainty_note: Metadata details not specified in flow description

title: Disclosure of sensitive grade records
description: The Grade Records Database shares sensitive personal grade data with the grading service, which may exceed minimal requirements for view building.

title: Propagation to multiple views
description: The Assignment & Grading Service receives grade records and uses them to build views for students, parents, and teachers, propagating personal data to additional parties.

title: Processing of identified grade data
description: The service processes identified student grade records containing unique identifiers to construct personalized views.

title: Identified information in data flow metadata
description: The data flow may carry metadata linking grades to specific students or sessions.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not specify metadata details, so this is inferred.
